artifact.not_redistributed: the converted .ninfer artifact (about 19.6 GB) is published with SHA256SUMS and is not part of this submission

toolchain.runtime_libraries: libcudart, libcublasLt from the CUDA 13.3 toolkit; FFmpeg and libcurl from the system (not redistributed)

runtime_prerequisites: Linux x86-64 with a 32 GB-class NVIDIA GPU (RTX 5090, sm_120a) and a CUDA 13.x driver/toolkit
CMake 3.28+, Ninja, a C++23 host compiler
FFmpeg development libraries (libavformat, libavcodec, libavutil, libswscale) and libcurl 7.85+
Python 3.11 with numpy and torch for the converter and the perplexity report; the runtime needs none
